description.en:
H2-D is Unitree's wheeled, dual-arm robot for mobile manipulation. Its 20-degree-of-freedom body combines force-controlled joints with omnidirectional movement, vertical lift and torso pitching, allowing the robot to position its arms within constrained workspaces.

The perception system brings together vision, lidar, ultrasonic sensing and force feedback, with audio interfaces for spoken interaction. Unitree provides development and customization interfaces for research, commercial and industrial applications. The platform's purpose is to connect mobile reach with manipulation, rather than reproduce bipedal walking. Actual handling behavior depends on the end effectors, control software and task integration.
